Row.Text: Lorenzo de' Medici, il Magnifico: banker, poet, diplomat, and the man who kept Italy at peace for twelve years and Florence full of workshops.
+2 [icon:YIELD_GOLD] Gold and +1 [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS] Happiness for each Great Work in a Settlement, and +1 [icon:YIELD_CULTURE] Culture in all Settlements.
How beautiful is youth, that flies from us so fast. Let who will be glad: of tomorrow there is no certainty.
